File tools can access shared storage beyond files you select, including private documents.
App lookup can see installed apps, including apps without launcher icons. Android grants this during installation.
Opens the Android installer when you choose to install an update. Android asks you to confirm.
The SMS tool can send texts, which may incur carrier charges.
Message search can read SMS text and sender details, including private messages.
Call history can include phone numbers, call direction and time.
Contact search can read names and contact information saved on this device.
Geofence triggers can check when the device enters or leaves an area even while ZeroAgent is closed.
Floating chat and automation status can appear over other apps.
Visual assistance can capture what is visible on the chosen screen. Android asks for consent at the start of each capture.
Allow ZeroAgent to install updates here, then return and tap Download and install again.
Allow location for this workflow

This workflow needs precise location to tell when you enter or leave the area. First allow location while using the app. Then allow background location in Android settings and try enabling the workflow again.
